The results, unveiled by the network's star data expert Steve Kornacki, found that Trump's overall approval rating landed at 36% – marking a record NBC polling low this term. That's also close to a low of 33% in a Reuters poll released last month.

The polling comes as Americans brace for the final quarter of the year amid economic fears and growing uncertainty about the Iran war. results.title: Trump's approval drops among Republicans ahead of midterms, new poll shows

results.content:
Trump still maintains strong support among Republicans, but the poll suggests that support isn't as solid as it once was.

Seventy-five percent of Republicans currently approve of his job performance. That's down from 89 percent in April 2025 — a 14-point decline. Approval among people who voted for Trump in 2024 has also fallen over the longer term, dropping from 87 percent in April 2025 to 77 percent today.
